class.name: Box3DRagdollProfileGenerator
class.description: Builds the authoring profile used by [Box3DRagdoll]. The generator fits one capsule per generated bone, uses vertices weighted to the bone when a skinned [MeshInstance3D] is supplied (mapped through the skin's bind poses so retargeted rests still line up), derives capsule mass from the runtime profile's density-based mass model, and can sample an [AnimationLibrary] to derive editable swing/twist limits. Capsules are fitted tip-to-tip over the bone span (hemisphere caps end at the joints), extended toward the tip when weighted geometry reaches past a stubby leaf bone (hands past a palm bone), and the radius comes from the median perpendicular distance of weighted vertices whose axial projection falls inside the span, so gear hanging past a joint does not inflate the fit. Importer [code]neutral_bone[/code] artifacts are skipped; secondary-motion bones (breast/hair/cloth helpers) and extremities (toes, palms, fingers) fold into their parent capsules so the forearm+hand and foot+toes each become one body; sibling bones whose fitted capsules mutually coincide are merged into a single body. Joint friction scales down with each bone's mass so light extremities relax instead of freezing, and anatomical caps tighten clavicle and ankle cones that animation envelopes overstate. Generated profiles store a per-bone [code]joint_frame[/code] whose origin is the anatomical connection at the bone origin and whose local X axis follows the anatomical bone axis; rotation tracks are converted to deltas from the rest pose and decomposed in that same frame before the runtime remaps spherical twist to Box3D's local Z axis. When animations are sampled, the union of every animation in the library is taken, the joint's neutral pose is re-centered on the mean sampled pose (stored as the entry's [code]rest_delta[/code]) so limit ranges always contain the neutral, and revolute bones re-aim their hinge axis at the dominant sampled rotation axis when the name-based guess does not match the rig. The editor exposes this API through [b]Generate Profile...[/b] in a [Box3DRagdoll] inspector. That workflow previews diagnostics before saving and assigning the external profile resource.

method.name: analyze_profile
method.description: Returns mass and count diagnostics for a generated profile.

method.name: clear_warnings
method.description: Clears warnings emitted by the last generation run.

method.name: generate_profile
method.description: Generates a profile from [param skeleton]. When [param mesh_instance] has skin weights, bones with no weighted vertices are skipped and vertices with weight at or above [member vertex_weight_threshold] drive capsule radius; otherwise bone length heuristics are used. When [param animation_library] is supplied, matching rotation tracks are sampled at 30 Hz and padded by [member animation_padding] to derive limits.

method.name: get_gizmo_lines
method.description: Returns all capsule wireframe, swing-cone, and twist-arc segments in world space. Each pair of points is one line segment. Use [method get_gizmo_line_groups] when chain colors are required.

method.name: get_gizmo_line_groups
method.description: Returns the same editor gizmo segments as [method get_gizmo_lines], grouped by the chain names in [member Box3DRagdollProfile.bone_chains]. Values are [PackedVector3Array] instances in world space.

method.name: get_warnings
method.description: Returns warnings emitted by the last generation run.

members.member: Padding in radians added to sampled animation limits.
Fallback capsule radius as a fraction of bone length when no weighted mesh vertices are available.
Maximum allowed mass ratio between generated parent and child capsules. The generator raises density scale on the lighter side when needed.

Upper bound in radians for animation-derived swing cones. The union of a whole animation library (aiming, sprinting, death poses) can span nearly the full sphere, which would leave the joint effectively unlimited.

Weighted bones whose rest-pose axis is shorter than this are not given bodies; their skin vertices are merged into the nearest kept ancestor's capsule fit instead. This collapses finger, toe, and helper chains into the hand/foot capsules. Set to [code]0.0[/code] to disable pruning. Only applies when generating from a skinned mesh.

When greater than zero, uniformly scales every generated bone's [code]density_scale[/code] so the profile's total mass equals this value. Mass ratios between bones are preserved. Set to [code]0.0[/code] to keep the mass derived from capsule volume.
Minimum skin weight for a mesh vertex to affect a bone's capsule fit.
